description: This file is the main entry point for the HTML report viewer in the Playwright project. It sets up React components, loads report data from a ZIP archive, and manages report state and rendering.

classes.name: ZipReport
classes.description: Handles loading and parsing the report ZIP archive, extracting report JSON, and providing access to report data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the report ZIP archive from various sources (element, window opener, local storage) and initializes report entries.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the loaded HTML report data.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a specific report entry from the ZIP archive.
